reasons.correctness: Implements the repository derived query, FaqService#purgeInactiveOlderThan (cutoff now minus days, deleteAll, returns count) and InactiveFaqPurgeCronJob with the stated properties and defaults. Disabled flag and catch/log work. Hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: The cron job uses @SchedulerLock(name="faq:inactivePurge"), cron and enabled flag from properties, the *CronJob name, and @RequiredArgsConstructor with a private final FaqService. Code stays in the support/faq feature package. No schema or i18n change was needed.
reasons.design_fit: Query logic sits in FaqRepository, deletion logic in FaqService, scheduling in a thin cron job that delegates, following the AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob structure. It adds no duplicate lookup and no new mechanism, and touches only the files the task needs.
reasons.test_quality: FaqService_PurgeUnitTest captures the cutoff and checks it falls within the expected window, and verifies deleteAll and the count, plus an empty case. InactiveFaqPurgeCronJobUnitTest covers enabled, disabled and exception-swallowed paths. Both use Mockito only, no Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries located the faq files and existing *CronJob classes, then followed TESTED_BY to AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJobUnitTest. The agent read those as exemplars and the edits mirror them. A later graph query found an AddressService test pattern.
